notes: Both arms continued metformin or placebo with clomiphene citrate after 7 weeks of pretreatment. Ovulation was defined by serum P level > or =4 ng/mL. The ovulation denominators are stated without explicit randomised or analysed qualification. Separate conception results are 6 of 11 participants (55%) and 1 of 14 participants (7%), respectively; these are not the requested ovulation outcome.
